messages.subject: Project Tempest - completion funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona, Gavin,

Attached is the completion funds flow for 27 February. Sources of £12.0m (£8.0m super-senior drawdown plus the £4.0m shareholder contribution) fund the £3.0m Facility B paydown, fees of c.£0.6m (amendment fee £210k, arrangement fee £160k, agency, legal and IBR costs) and £8.0m of net cash to WCB's balance sheet for working capital. It ties to nil.

Gavin - please confirm Sterling's account details for the fee payments. Fiona - please arrange for the £4.0m shareholder contribution to be available in cleared funds on completion morning.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
